description: Buy cargo at your port's price today. Ports refuse trade at notoriety 3 or more. Unsigned guest play works and is labeled guest provenance; P-256 signing is optional and only upgrades the label to key verified. If you do sign, use action salt_sea_action with payload {action: 'buy', agentLabel, good, qty}.

good.description: grain | timber | ore | cloth | salt | spice
